title: A hat function based positive contact discontinuity capturing Boltzmann scheme
summary: The suitable moments of the Maxwell velocity distribution function recover the conserved variable and flux vectors of the Euler equations of gas dynamics. However, the Maxwellian has infinite support in velocity space, which poses challenges for the numerical analysis of kinetic schemes based on it. Although Maxwellian is a natural choice, it is not the only distribution function that preserves these key moments.
